# MPI002 `isend-buffer-modified-before-completion`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

The buffer of a pending `mpi_isend` is written before the request is completed.

## Why

A non-blocking send may read its buffer at any time until `mpi_wait`/`mpi_test` completes the
request. Writing the buffer in between changes what is sent, depending on timing: the receiver gets
old values, new values, or a mix, and the run is not reproducible. Complete the request before
reusing the buffer, or double-buffer.

## Reported

```fortran
call mpi_isend(halo, n, MPI_REAL8, dst, 0, comm, req, ierr)
halo = q(1:n)               ! the send may still be reading halo
call mpi_wait(req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE, ierr)
```

## Preferred

```fortran
call mpi_isend(halo, n, MPI_REAL8, dst, 0, comm, req, ierr)
call mpi_wait(req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE, ierr)
halo = q(1:n)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MPI002] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MPI002` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).
